import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static List<Integer> combinations = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[][] prob = new int[10][10];
    static long[] dp1 = new long[1 << 20];
    static long[] dp2 = new long[1 << 20];

    static long modPow(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                prob[i][j] = (int) ((long) val * modPow(100, MOD - 2) % MOD);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = n; i <= 5; i++) {
            prob[i][i] = 1;
        }
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < 64; mask++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == 3) {
                combinations.add(mask);
            }
        }
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); mask++) {
            boolean[][] grid = new boolean[6][6];
            long product = 1;
            int bitPos = 0;
            
            for (int row = 0; row < 6; row++) {
                for (int col = 0; col <= 2; col++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << bitPos)) != 0) {
                        grid[row][col] = true;
                        product = (product * prob[row][col]) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        product = (product * ((1 - prob[row][col] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
                    }
                    bitPos++;
                }
            }
            
            int combinedMask = 0;
            for (int idx = 0; idx < combinations.size(); idx++) {
                int combo = combinations.get(idx);
                int[] indices = new int[3];
                int cnt = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
                    if ((combo & (1 << k)) != 0) indices[cnt++] = k;
                }
                
                int i1 = indices[0], i2 = indices[1], i3 = indices[2];
                if ((grid[i1][0] && grid[i2][1] && grid[i3][2]) ||
                    (grid[i1][0] && grid[i2][2] && grid[i3][1]) ||
                    (grid[i1][1] && grid[i2][0] && grid[i3][2]) ||
                    (grid[i1][1] && grid[i2][2] && grid[i3][0]) ||
                    (grid[i1][2] && grid[i2][0] && grid[i3][1]) ||
                    (grid[i1][2] && grid[i2][1] && grid[i3][0])) {
                    combinedMask |= (1 << idx);
                }
            }
            
            dp1[combinedMask] = (dp1[combinedMask] + product) % MOD;
        }
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); mask++) {
            boolean[][] grid = new boolean[6][6];
            long product = 1;
            int bitPos = 0;
            
            for (int row = 0; row < 6; row++) {
                for (int col = 3; col <= 5; col++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << bitPos)) != 0) {
                        grid[row][col] = true;
                        product = (product * prob[row][col]) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        product = (product * ((1 - prob[row][col] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
                    }
                    bitPos++;
                }
            }
            
            int combinedMask = 0;
            for (int idx = 0; idx < combinations.size(); idx++) {
                int combo = combinations.get(idx);
                int complement = combo ^ 63;
                int[] indices = new int[3];
                int cnt = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
                    if ((complement & (1 << k)) != 0) indices[cnt++] = k;
                }
                
                int i1 = indices[0], i2 = indices[1], i3 = indices[2];
                if ((grid[i1][3] && grid[i2][4] && grid[i3][5]) ||
                    (grid[i1][3] && grid[i2][5] && grid[i3][4]) ||
                    (grid[i1][4] && grid[i2][3] && grid[i3][5]) ||
                    (grid[i1][4] && grid[i2][5] && grid[i3][3]) ||
                    (grid[i1][5] && grid[i2][3] && grid[i3][4]) ||
                    (grid[i1][5] && grid[i2][4] && grid[i3][3])) {
                    combinedMask |= (1 << idx);
                }
            }
            
            dp2[combinedMask] = (dp2[combinedMask] + product) % MOD;
        }
        
        for (int bit = 0; bit < 20; bit++) {
            for (int mask = (1 << 20) - 1; mask >= 0; mask--) {
                if ((mask & (1 << bit)) != 0) {
                    dp2[mask] = (dp2[mask] + dp2[mask ^ (1 << bit)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        
        long result = 0;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 20); mask++) {
            result = (result + dp1[mask] * dp2[((1 << 20) - 1) ^ mask]) % MOD;
        }
        
        System.out.println((1 - result + MOD) % MOD);
    }
}
